gigapan.description:
This is a small (~ 2.5mm x 1mm) bug from the Carnegie Museum of Natural History (CMNH). The image set was composed of 133 focus stacks x 8 long and 5 wide, totalling 5320 images.

This image has many problems introduced during the focus stacking and stitching steps. This is particularly obvious on the top side of the bugs head where it's second eye is missing.
